original_target.title: Classical hardness of learning parity with noise
original_target.area: Statistical learning and average-case computational complexity

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original requires all uniform randomized polynomial-time classical algorithms with polynomially many random dense examples, constant0<eta<1/2 and negligible search success. Aggarwal et al current worst-case reductions remain conditional and use low-noise transformed parameters. Quantum/coherent samples, sparse parity, preprocessing advice and exponential-in-dimension exhaustive search do not satisfy the target. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
